track: Track 02: The Agent That Can Explain Why
description: Multi-agent screening of Singapore public-procurement awards for agency internal auditors: every item is an anomaly for review, with the Zetaris query, source rows and AGO context behind it.
wording_policy: Findings are anomalies for review, never conclusions of fraud or wrongdoing; a human auditor decides.

entry_points.docker: docker build -t oah-submission . && docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 -e SAMPLE_MODE=true oah-submission
entry_points.web: cd web && npm install && npm run dev  (Next.js on http://127.0.0.1:3100, optional)

sample_mode.offline_condition: SAMPLE_MODE=true with no Zetaris key and no Nightshift token: answers come only from recorded sets in data/replay/, no network
sample_mode.live_first_condition: With at least one credential set, live services are tried first; recordings answer only after outage-type failures
sample_mode.labels: ids prefixed replay:, model suffixed (replayed), memo limitation line

zetaris.role: Data layer: all agent data access goes through Zetaris REST (app/adapters/zetaris.py)
zetaris.usl_model: procurement_usl (namespace lightning.metastore.procurement); registered and verified by scripts/register_zetaris.py, demonstrated in scripts/usl_demo.sql; agent checks query the registered sources directly
agents_using_it: CriticAgent (re-runs check SQL, R3 address density, plan coverage)

meterless_hmem.implementation: services/hmem (TypeScript, adapted from the Meterless reference, Apache-2.0)
meterless_hmem.feature: Auditor Confirm/Dismiss decisions are stored; the Critic suppresses an exactly dismissed finding (same UEN, flag, agency) or down-weights a dismissed pattern; the Planner recalls agency memory

meterless_nightshift.role: Primary and only AI provider (OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions); no NVIDIA key in the app

nvidia.resolver_tiebreak_model: routed per call by Nightshift: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b on 22 Oct (docs/handover/d1-data.md section 8), nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b on 24 Oct

data_sources.name: Planted cases and synthetic internal records
data_sources.origin: written by the team, fictional suppliers only

red_flags.r4_note: partial: GeBIZ holds no quotation (ETQ) records

tests.hmem_conformance: cd services/hmem && npm install && HMEM_IMPL="$(pwd)/src/index.ts" npx tsx ../hmem-upstream/conformance/runner.ts

limitations: Offline mode covers only the recorded inputs
